preparation_steps: Mix fubá, wheat flour, salt, and saffron in a bowl
Gradually add water while kneading the dough until it becomes elastic
Form small balls and boil them three times (each time boiling and cooling in cold water)
Coat the balls with fubá for storage in the fridge
fishing_techniques: Use small bait balls for Piau (small fish)
Use medium-sized bait balls for Piapara
Use larger bait balls for Pacu and Piau Sul
Combine with corn or bigato (another bait type) for better results
Use a carretilha (reel) with a specific tackle setup
Adjust hook size based on target fish species
